title: The GT sensitivity tables show the same value in every cell
evidence: In the GT, every data-table cell in all four LBO sensitivity grids ('Ex 1 - LBO'!AG18:AK22, AG27:AK31, AG36:AK40, AG45:AK49) has the cached value '2.4x/19%'. That is the same as the corner cell AF17 (=TEXT(AC28,"0.0x")&"/"&TEXT(AC29,"0%")). The tables vary exit multiple, growth, leverage and senior rate, but every result is identical, so they show no sensitivity at all. These 95 cells are graded: all of them except AG18, AG27, AG36 and AG45 are modification cells, because the input holds '=#VALUE!' and the GT holds '=TABLE(...)'.
confirmation: In the GT, AG18, AH19 and AK49 (all =TABLE(...)) cache '2.4x/19%', the same as corner cell AF17, so the graded sensitivity grids hold one value. A correctly recalculated table can't match these modification cells.
fix: answer_position no longer includes the four TABLE grids 'Ex 1 - LBO'!AG18:AK22, AG27:AK31, AG36:AK40, AG45:AK49 (the verifier freezes TABLE cells to whatever the output cached, so no recalculated table can be graded fairly).

title: The prompt asks for an open-ended audit, but the grader accepts only the exact cells the GT changed
evidence: The prompt says: 'Please audit and fix this file thoroughly. Errors may include but are not limited to: formula logic errors..., hardcoded values that should be formulas, ..., inconsistent formatting or naming conventions, best practice violations...'. The GT changes only three things: it anchors the mixed references in 'Ex 1 - LBO'!Q78:U78 ($C$47), 'Ex 4'!O22:Q22 ($R$22-$N$22) and 'Ex 5 - M&A'!C19:G19 ($C$4), and it restores the data tables. Grading is binary: every modification cell must match, and 99.8% of the regression cells over very large ranges must stay unchanged. An agent that also fixes other things the prompt invites, such as replacing hardcodes with formulas or fixing the odd array formula 'Ex 1 - LBO'!C36 ='Ex 10 - Balance Sheet'!D8:D8/C7, will change downstream values in LBO/M&A and can fail the 0.2% regression budget. Nothing in the prompt says that only the reference errors count.
confirmation: The prompt invites fixing any errors, but the GT changes only three reference ranges plus the data tables and leaves real errors in graded ranges (e.g. Ex 5 Z58 using $S33). Fixes that change values break the 99.8% regression bar, and all 3 runs scored regression 0.967-0.971.
fix: gt_01_golden.xlsx now also fixes the errors QA named (other cells, formulas and styles unchanged; 391 dependent cached values rewritten from the verifier's LibreOffice recalc): 'Ex 5 - M&A'!C4 hardcoded 3 -> =+'Ex 1 - LBO'!$C$9 like 'Ex 4'!C4 (the active case follows the LBO Operating Case, 1, which also clears the 15 #DIV/0! cells E43:G43, D53:G53, D63:G63, D73:G73 and flows into the LBO, Ex 2 and Ex 3); Downside EBITDA cohorts Z58:AB58, AA59:AB59, AB60 now use the Downside counts $Z33/$AA33/$AB33 (were Upside $S33/$T33/$U33); Downside '% Margin' rows Y53:AB53, Y63:AB63, Y73:AB73 now =+IFERROR(Y52/Y42,"N/A") etc. (were YoY growth); 'Ex 1 - LBO'!C36 ='Ex 10 - Balance Sheet'!D8/C7 (was the array formula D8:D8/C7, same value). answer_position: the earlier Ex 5 exclusions are put back except Y53:AB53, Y63:AB63, Y73:AB73: the repaired margin is 0/0 (Downside has no revenue), and '#DIV/0!' and 'N/A' are equally valid results that the scorer cannot match to each other, so those 12 cells stay out. The four LBO TABLE grids stay out as before. Checked with the real SB2 scorer: new key vs itself 1.0, input plus all key fixes 1.0, untouched input 0.0, planted-only fixes (old key) 0.0 (expected).

title: The answer key fails its own verifier because its cached values are stale, so no one can pass
evidence: I copied gt_01_golden.xlsx to /home/model/Desktop/output.xlsx and ran verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells with the spec.yaml parameters. The result was score=0.0, 'FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.7440. 65 cell error(s)'. The cached values in the GT come from a leftover data-table/sensitivity substitution, not from the model's real inputs. For example, 'Ex 1 - LBO'!C11 (=+C20) has a cached value of 18.2034, but it recalculates to 14.2034, the base exit multiple in AI17. That stale value spreads through the model: C32 109.5182 vs 101.3452; C34 11968.04 vs 11074.90; F20 215.42 vs 199.35; F28 12412.84 vs 11510.77; X23:AC26 8987.82 vs 8101.82; U43 0.264 vs 0.2215; 'Ex 2 - Valuation Bridge'!C3 9203.24 vs 8301.17; 'Ex 5 - M&A'!J75/Q75 18.2034 vs 14.2034 and C75/X75 17.81209 vs 14.2034; K79:U81 136.53/122.87/273.05 vs 106.53/95.87/213.05. The verifier recalculates the output in LibreOffice and requires 100% of modification cells to match, so even the reference solution scores 0. This is the problem's only check (weight 1, all-or-nothing).
confirmation: The GT's cached values contradict its formulas: C11 '=+C20' caches 18.2034 while C20 is 14.2034, and C32 caches 109.5182 vs 81.73*1.24=101.3452. Every run's grade.json lists exactly these as modification errors, so the key fails its own verifier.
fix: Replaced gt_01_golden.xlsx with a copy whose 65 stale cached values are rewritten to the verifier's own LibreOffice recalculation (e.g. 'Ex 1 - LBO'!C11 18.2034 -> 14.2034, C32 109.5182 -> 101.3452, F28, U17, X23:AC26, 'Ex 2 - Valuation Bridge'!C3, 'Ex 5 - M&A'!C75/J75/Q75/X75, K79:U81). Formulas, styles and TABLE formulas are untouched; the patched GT now scores 1.0 on its own verifier.

title: Inconsistent ground-truth caches cause the golden workbook itself to fail grading
evidence: The verifier force-recalculates submissions but compares them against unrecalculated cached values in gt_01_golden.xlsx. Those caches contradict the workbook's formulas. On 'Ex 1 - LBO', C32 is '=+C30*(1+C31)' with C30=81.73 and C31=0.24, which calculates to 101.3452, but the expected cache is 109.5182. C11 is '=+C20' but caches 18.2034 while C20 is 14.2033949536391. Cached Total Sources F22=11510.772151908 also differs from Total Uses F28=12412.840791578 by 902.06863967. Passing the golden workbook through the verifier's own forced-recalculation and comparison path produces 65 cell errors, regression ratio 1.0000 and modification ratio 0.7440. Consequently, the golden workbook fails the sole weight-1, all-or-nothing verification, and correctly recalculated formulas are penalized.
confirmation: GT C32 '=+C30*(1+C31)' (81.73, 0.24) caches 109.5182 instead of 101.3452, and C11 '=+C20' caches 18.2034 vs C20 14.2034. The verifier compares recalculated output to these stale caches, so the golden workbook fails.
fix: Replaced gt_01_golden.xlsx with a copy whose 65 stale cached values are rewritten to the verifier's own LibreOffice recalculation (e.g. 'Ex 1 - LBO'!C11 18.2034 -> 14.2034, C32 109.5182 -> 101.3452, F28, U17, X23:AC26, 'Ex 2 - Valuation Bridge'!C3, 'Ex 5 - M&A'!C75/J75/Q75/X75, K79:U81). Formulas, styles and TABLE formulas are untouched; the patched GT now scores 1.0 on its own verifier.

title: Broad task instruction asks agent to fix all formula logic and reference errors, but ground truth only fixes 3 reference ranges and penalizes fixing other broken formulas in 'Ex 5 - M&A'
evidence: In `problem.py:42`, the prompt instructs: "Please audit and fix this file thoroughly. Errors may include but are not limited to: formula logic errors or inconsistencies, hardcoded values that should be formulas, broken cell references, data validation issues, potential calculation errors, inconsistent formatting or naming conventions, best practice violations, and any other issues that could affect accuracy or maintainability." However, `gt_01_golden.xlsx` only changes `'Ex 1 - LBO'!Q78:U78` (`$C$47`), `'Ex 4 - Organic Operating Model'!O22:Q22` (`$R$22-$N$22`), `'Ex 5 - M&A'!C19:G19` (`$C$4`), and the four `'Ex 1 - LBO'` data tables (`AG18:AK49`), while leaving multiple obvious errors on `'Ex 5 - M&A'` unfixed in the graded range `'Ex 5 - M&A'!B1:AB81`: (1) `'Ex 5 - M&A'!C4` is formatted in green cross-sheet link font (matching `'Ex 4 - Organic Operating Model'!C4` which has `=+'Ex 1 - LBO'!$C$9`), but is hardcoded to `3` (Downside Case) instead of linking to `'Ex 1 - LBO'`; (2) Downside Case EBITDA cohort cells `'Ex 5 - M&A'!Z58:AB58`, `AA59:AB59`, `AB60` reference Upside Case acquisition counts (`$S33`, `$T33`, `$U33`) instead of Downside Case counts (`$Z33`, `$AA33`, `$AB33`), giving positive EBITDA when Downside Case Revenue and Gross Profit are 0; (3) Downside Case `% Margin` rows (`Y53:AB53`, `Y63:AB63`, `Y73:AB73`) compute YoY growth (`Y52/X52-1`) instead of margin (`Y52/Y42`); and (4) Active Case ratio rows (`E43:G43`, `D53:G53`, `D63:G63`, `D73:G73`) evaluate to 15 `#DIV/0!` errors. Because `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` (weight 1.0) treats all unchanged cells in `'Ex 5 - M&A'!B1:AB81` as regression cells and requires a 0.998 regression pass ratio, an agent that fixes these `'Ex 5 - M&A'` defects as instructed fails the regression check (as occurred in all 3 attempts, which got regression ratios of 0.9669–0.9707).
confirmation: GT leaves real errors in the graded 'Ex 5 - M&A' range, e.g. Z58:AB58 '=+$S33*X$19*X$28' uses the Upside count S33 in the Downside block (Z33=0), and Y53 is a YoY growth formula in a '% Margin' row. Fixing them as the 'audit thoroughly' prompt asks changes regression cells beyond the 0.2% budget.
fix: gt_01_golden.xlsx now also fixes the errors QA named (other cells, formulas and styles unchanged; 391 dependent cached values rewritten from the verifier's LibreOffice recalc): 'Ex 5 - M&A'!C4 hardcoded 3 -> =+'Ex 1 - LBO'!$C$9 like 'Ex 4'!C4 (the active case follows the LBO Operating Case, 1, which also clears the 15 #DIV/0! cells E43:G43, D53:G53, D63:G63, D73:G73 and flows into the LBO, Ex 2 and Ex 3); Downside EBITDA cohorts Z58:AB58, AA59:AB59, AB60 now use the Downside counts $Z33/$AA33/$AB33 (were Upside $S33/$T33/$U33); Downside '% Margin' rows Y53:AB53, Y63:AB63, Y73:AB73 now =+IFERROR(Y52/Y42,"N/A") etc. (were YoY growth); 'Ex 1 - LBO'!C36 ='Ex 10 - Balance Sheet'!D8/C7 (was the array formula D8:D8/C7, same value). answer_position: the earlier Ex 5 exclusions are put back except Y53:AB53, Y63:AB63, Y73:AB73: the repaired margin is 0/0 (Downside has no revenue), and '#DIV/0!' and 'N/A' are equally valid results that the scorer cannot match to each other, so those 12 cells stay out. The four LBO TABLE grids stay out as before. Checked with the real SB2 scorer: new key vs itself 1.0, input plus all key fixes 1.0, untouched input 0.0, planted-only fixes (old key) 0.0 (expected).

title: Ground truth workbook (gt_01_golden.xlsx) has corrupted cached values from LibreOffice data-table evaluation and fails its own verifier
evidence: The sole verifier `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (`verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells`, weight 1.0) passes `output_path` through `managed_recalculated_xlsx(..., force_recalculation=True)`, which calls `freeze_datatable_formulas` before running LibreOffice Calc so that `TABLE(...)` formulas do not corrupt live model cells during recalculation. However, `score_workbooks` compares that cleanly recalculated output against the raw, unrecalculated cached values in `gt_01_golden.xlsx` and `untouched_input_Relative vs Absolute References_input.xlsx`. Because `gt_01_golden.xlsx` was saved by LibreOffice without freezing its four 5x5 sensitivity tables on `'Ex 1 - LBO'` (`AG18:AK22`, `AG27:AK31`, `AG36:AK40`, `AG45:AK49`), it suffers from both LibreOffice Multiple Operations bugs documented in `libreoffice.py`: (1) all 100 sensitivity-table cells in `gt_01_golden.xlsx` cache the identical base-case string `'2.4x/19%'` instead of the scenario-specific MOIC/IRR values, and (2) evaluating the final grid cells (`AK22`, `AK31`, `AK40`, `AK49`) destructively substituted table header values (`C31=0.34` instead of `0.24`, `C20=18.2034` instead of `14.203395`, `C11=17.81209` instead of `14.203395`, `M17=0.137` instead of `0.092`, `M27=0.264` instead of `0.221507`) into live model cells and stranded 65 dependent cells across `'Ex 1 - LBO'`, `'Ex 2 - Valuation Bridge'`, and `'Ex 5 - M&A'` with corrupted cached values (e.g., `'Ex 1 - LBO'!C11` has formula `=+C20` and cached value `18.2034` while `C20` in the same file is `14.2033949536391`; `'Ex 1 - LBO'!C32` has formula `=+C30*(1+C31)` with `C30=81.73, C31=0.24` and cached value `109.5182` instead of `101.3452`). Passing `gt_01_golden.xlsx` itself to `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` yields `score=0.0` (`FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.7440. 65 cell error(s)`).
confirmation: gt_01_golden.xlsx caches '2.4x/19%' in every TABLE cell (AG18, AH19, AK49...) and has corrupted live caches (C11=18.2034 vs C20=14.2034, C32=109.5182). The recalculated output is compared against these stale caches, so the GT fails its own verifier.
fix: Replaced gt_01_golden.xlsx with a copy whose 65 stale cached values are rewritten to the verifier's own LibreOffice recalculation (e.g. 'Ex 1 - LBO'!C11 18.2034 -> 14.2034, C32 109.5182 -> 101.3452, F28, U17, X23:AC26, 'Ex 2 - Valuation Bridge'!C3, 'Ex 5 - M&A'!C75/J75/Q75/X75, K79:U81). Formulas, styles and TABLE formulas are untouched; the patched GT now scores 1.0 on its own verifier. The data-table grids are also removed from answer_position (see F1).

title: Golden gate: the ground-truth deliverable does not score full reward
evidence: The ground-truth deliverable, staged at the verifiers' own output paths and graded by the problem's real grader, scored 0.00 (need >= 1.00). A correct answer that does not earn full reward means a verifier false-negatives the mandated work. With the ground truth staged, every one of the 1 checks on /home/model/Desktop/output.xlsx scored 0 (summed weight 1.000), which is the whole shortfall of the GT grade. A correct deliverable does not fail every check at once; the ground truth for this file most likely never reached the grader (paired with a file of another type or name), so these are not 1 separate verifier defects. Checks: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check.
confirmation: The GT cannot score 1.0: its cached values are stale (C11 '=+C20' caches 18.2034 while C20=14.2034, C32 caches 109.5182 vs 101.3452 computed). A force-recalculated copy of it therefore fails modification cells. The finding's guess about file staging is off, but the shortfall is real.
fix: Replaced gt_01_golden.xlsx with a copy whose 65 stale cached values are rewritten to the verifier's own LibreOffice recalculation (e.g. 'Ex 1 - LBO'!C11 18.2034 -> 14.2034, C32 109.5182 -> 101.3452, F28, U17, X23:AC26, 'Ex 2 - Valuation Bridge'!C3, 'Ex 5 - M&A'!C75/J75/Q75/X75, K79:U81). Formulas, styles and TABLE formulas are untouched; the patched GT now scores 1.0 on its own verifier.

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells cannot pass on any recalculated workbook (including gt_01_golden.xlsx) due to data-table corruption in the ground truth
evidence: `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (`verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells`, weight 1.0) scored 0.0 across all 3 units (unit 1: regression 0.9679, modification 0.1353; unit 2: regression 0.9707, modification 0.1353; unit 3: regression 0.9669, modification 0.0435), reporting the exact same Modification errors on `'Ex 1 - LBO'!C11` (`answer=18.2034, output=14.2033949536391`), `C32` (`answer=109.5182, output=101.3452`), `C34` (`answer=11968.0393778, output=11074.9021108`), `C37` (`answer=12289.9413778, output=11396.8041108`), and `F20` (`answer=215.4247088004, output=199.3482379944`). Independent assessment of the trajectories shows that all 3 units correctly identified and fixed the relative-vs-absolute reference bugs (`'Ex 1 - LBO'!Q78:U78`, `'Ex 4 - Organic Operating Model'!O22:Q22`, `'Ex 5 - M&A'!C19:G19`) and computed the four 5x5 sensitivity tables on `'Ex 1 - LBO'` (`AG18:AK49`), and that `14.2033949536391` (`C11 = +C20`) and `101.3452` (`C32 = 81.73 * (1 + 0.24)`) are the mathematically correct base-case values. Because `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` freezes data-table formulas and recalculates `output_path` in LibreOffice while reading `gt_01_golden.xlsx` without recalculation (where 65 model cells are stranded at the last sensitivity-table inputs and all 96 modified sensitivity-table cells hold the constant base-case string `'2.4x/19%'`), even `gt_01_golden.xlsx` itself fails `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` with score 0.0 and the exact same 65 cell errors.
confirmation: All 3 grade.json files fail on the same GT cells (C11 answer 18.2034 vs 14.2034, C32 109.5182 vs 101.3452). GT C32 '=+C30*(1+C31)' with C30=81.73 and C31=0.24 caches 109.5182, a stale value, so no recalculated workbook can match.
fix: Replaced gt_01_golden.xlsx with a copy whose 65 stale cached values are rewritten to the verifier's own LibreOffice recalculation (e.g. 'Ex 1 - LBO'!C11 18.2034 -> 14.2034, C32 109.5182 -> 101.3452, F28, U17, X23:AC26, 'Ex 2 - Valuation Bridge'!C3, 'Ex 5 - M&A'!C75/J75/Q75/X75, K79:U81). Formulas, styles and TABLE formulas are untouched; the patched GT now scores 1.0 on its own verifier.
